messages:
maya: Quick q — where's the saved search for logs scoped to org=acme model=gen-xl route=/chat region=ap-sg? trying to tune the 503 alert :thinking:

oliver: There is one in LogSearch. Dashboard -> Saved searches -> "acme/ap-sg/gen-xl/chat". Quick query I use:
```
org:\"acme\" AND model:\"gen-xl\" AND route:\"/chat\" AND region:\"ap-sg\" AND status >= 500
| parse \"status=%{INT:status}\"
| stats count() by status
```

liam: Heads up — alert firing on intermittent 503s. Would suggest excluding 429s and switch to `count>3 in last 5m` + an override for p95 latency. Current rule is too sensitive :slightly_frowning_face:

ana: If you're going to use it across teams, tag it `ops,acme,gen-xl` and pin to the "regional-route" folder so oncall can find it quickly.

oliver: done — I pinned the saved search and added tags. permalink: https://logsearch.redwood.internal/saved/34567 :pushpin:

oliver: Also added a variant that filters `status=503` only and a 1m/5m ratio check.

maya: Perfect. Can you also add the alert tweak as a PR? small change in alerting repo, ping @oncall for review.

liam: I'll open the PR in infra-alerts and reference the savedsearch id. Suggested alert snippet:
```
condition:
  query: saved_search_id=34567 AND status=503
  threshold: count > 3 for 5m
  mute_if: p95_latency < 300ms
```

sre-bot: Tip: to save programmatically use API `POST /api/saved_searches` with body `{name,query,tags}`. Example:
```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"name\":\"acme/ap-sg/gen-xl/chat\",\"query\":\"org:\\\"acme\\\" AND ...\",\"tags\":[\"ops\",\"acme\"]}' \\
  https://logsearch.redwood.internal/api/saved_searches
```

maya: awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
